subject: How does packrat determine package dependencies?

messages.author: db3e727b0ff852e7
messages.subject: How does packrat determine package dependencies?
parts:
Hi,
Does packrat pay attention to the DESCRIPTION file?  For example, I have specified in my description   "jsonlite (== 0.9.8)".  but packrat pulled down jasonlite 0.9.7.  How does packrat know what sources to use?

Thanks,
Brian

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: How does packrat determine package dependencies?
parts:
Hi Brian,

Right now, Packrat only captures package names, not versions, from the DESCRIPTION file. If it pulled jsonlite 0.9.7, I imagine it is because you currently have that version installed in the user library -- packrat will default to matching package versions in the user library when first initializing a project (just so that states are 'matched').

You can use `old.packages()` and `update.packages()` to see if you have any CRAN packages that need updates; we're also trying to implement something similar for packages living on GitHub / other repositories.

Thanks,
Kevin
